name: App Template
description: TEMPLATE — the fastest way to start a new aw-workspace app. Install it and you have a working app on day one: a `hello` CLI that prints a configurable greeting, its own window in the Apps grid, and an HTTP + WebSocket backend — with tests and marketplace release already wired. Rename everything marked TEMPLATE/hello to make it yours; see README.md.

skills.description: How to author a decoupled aw-workspace app from this template — manifest, tiers, capabilities, contributes, backend routes (HTTP+WS), frontend code, standalone mode, window widgets, install + marketplace release.

greeting.description: Word the installed `hello` command prints before the target name, e.g. "Hello, world!".
